scenes.say: Saturday rush. Every plate in the house is dirty. Then Rosa gets to work.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: Plates are back. All of them. Clean. Rosa, you're a legend.

props.name: Dev
props.quote: Plates are back. All of them. *Clean.*

scenes.say: The dish pit keeps the line in plates. It spots the chipped glass before a guest does. And it's usually the last one out at night.
No dishwasher, no service. So thank yours by name tonight.
Send this to your dish crew. Follow for more cafe life.
